fees.name: Ordinary visa, single entry, 1 month (embassy-issued)
fees.notes: Embassy of the DRC (Washington DC) fee schedule. Single entry: 1 month $100, 2 months $135, 6 months $400. Fees non-refundable.

fees.name: Ordinary visa, multiple entry (embassy-issued)
fees.notes: Multiple entry: 1 month $120, 2 months $150, 3 months $160, 6 months $450.

fees.name: Business visa (embassy-issued, same ordinary-visa fee schedule)
fees.notes: Business travel uses the ordinary visa fee tiers (single entry from $100, multiple entry from $120). US citizens instead pay $185 for a 2-year visa under the US-DRC reciprocity agreement.

fees.name: e-Visa (evisa.gouv.cd, DGM)
fees.notes: DRC operates an official e-visa portal run by the Direction Generale de Migration (DGM), but the fee schedule is only shown inside the JavaScript application and could not be verified directly; third-party sources cite around $300 online plus the $90 border entry fee (VAP). Amount left null rather than guessed. Related DGM 'visa volant' authorization fees are reported at $250 (ordinary) / $800 (specific) plus $50 file fees. Official portal FAQ (evisa.gouv.cd/helps/faqs, per prior confirmed session) states total e-visa cost USD 300 (USD 50 non-refundable admin fee + USD 250 visa fee); processing 72 hours; single entry; VAP of USD 90 payable separately at the border.

fees.name: Border entry fee / visa on arrival (VAP - visa aeroportuaire/portuaire)
fees.applies: travellers arriving with e-visa or visa volant authorization
fees.notes: USD 90 payable in cash at the point of entry (e.g. N'djili International Airport, land/sea borders); mandatory for holders of e-visa/visa volant pre-authorizations. Widely corroborated; official portal FAQ could not be scraped directly (JS-rendered).

fees.name: Visa for Zimbabwean transport drivers (30 days)
fees.notes: Applies only to Zimbabwean transport drivers: DRC abolished their visa exemption in April 2025 and they now require a 30-day visa costing USD 50. General Zimbabwean visitors remain visa-free.

reciprocity_variations.note: US-DRC reciprocity agreement: 2-year visa for tourism, study and business at $185 (Embassy of the DRC in Washington DC).

vfs.note: No outsourced visa application centre (VFS Global/TLScontact/BLS) found for DRC visas; applications go through DRC embassies/consulates or the official DGM e-visa portal.
